title: Asset rollback must restore metadata identity
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: Unity Editor generated assets. This is distinct from source-sync deletion risk and does not prove every filesystem or editor failure boundary.
goal: Roll back generated menu assets after a later build step fails.
approach: Historical failed assumption: An asset's payload bytes were treated as its complete transactional state.
what_worked: Historical correction: Snapshot and restore content and metadata before forced import; check transitive references after recovery. Verification reported by the source: An injected fault after generation/page deletion restored asset bytes, metadata bytes, GUID/local fileID and root dependencies. The historical validator passed its bounded rollback controls.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Restoring serialized asset content alone lost metadata-backed reference identity after generated pages were deleted.
why: Confirmed source gap: rollback snapshots omitted .meta identity.
improved_method: Include identity metadata and reference graphs in asset snapshots. Inject failure after deletion and verify references, not just content equality.
when_to_use: Unity Editor generated assets. This is distinct from source-sync deletion risk and does not prove every filesystem or editor failure boundary.
when_not_to_use: This is distinct from source-sync deletion risk and does not prove every filesystem or editor failure boundary.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
